name: Hitsuji-tachi no Yuuutsu ~Concrete ni Utsuru Kage~
original_name: 羊たちの憂鬱～コンクリートに映る影～
source: Hiroto, is sexually abused by his childhood friend, Natsuki. Seeking an escape from everyday suffering and in attempt to find love and protection, he starts to hang out with his classmate, Yuki. However, Natsuki has her own plans on him.
translation: 广人被他儿时的朋友夏树性虐待。为了摆脱日常的痛苦，并试图寻找爱和保护，他开始和他的同学由希一起出去玩。然而，夏希对他有自己的计划。
